{{Top|leg}}
An '''Environmental hydrographer''' evaluated the condition of bodies of water on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]], such as [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]], rivers, and lakes. They were also known as "water boys" in the professional circles of the environmental impact industry. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Evan Chan]] was working as an environmental hydrographer for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="DarkRendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>
